name: vscode-workbench-workspace
description: A configurable VS Code-style workbench built with React, TypeScript, Vite and vscode-elements.

scripts.dev:docs: node scripts/sync-docs-raw.mjs && node scripts/generate-llms.mjs --site-dir docs-site/content/public && npm run dev -w @workbench-kit/docs-site
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && tsc -b && npm run build -w @workbench-kit/template-app
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @workbench-kit/core && npm run build -w @workbench-kit/react && npm run build -w @workbench-kit/elements && npm run build -w @workbench-kit/preset-vscode && npm run build:facade
scripts.build:docs: node scripts/sync-docs-raw.mjs && node scripts/generate-llms.mjs --site-dir docs-site/content/public && npm run build -w @workbench-kit/docs-site
scripts.build:site: npm run build && npm run build:minimal && npm run build:custom-shell && npm run build:docs && node scripts/assemble-pages-site.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:distribution && npm run check:docs:contributor && npm run check:docs:consumer && npm run check:release && npm run check:styles && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:quickstart && npm run check:adoption && npm run build:minimal && npm run check:minimal && npm run build:custom-shell && npm run check:custom-shell && npm run pack:check
scripts.size: node scripts/size-report.mjs --target full-preset --build build --dist apps/template/dist --budget budgets.json --report size-report.json
scripts.size:minimal: node scripts/size-report.mjs --target minimal-example --build build:minimal --dist apps/minimal/dist --budget budgets.minimal.json --report size-report.minimal.json --compare budgets.json
scripts.check:minimal: node scripts/check-example-bundle.mjs --dist apps/minimal/dist --label minimal --build-command "npm run build:minimal" --style-config apps/minimal/style-subset.json
scripts.check:custom-shell: node scripts/check-example-bundle.mjs --dist apps/custom-shell/dist --label custom-shell --build-command "npm run build:custom-shell" --style-config apps/custom-shell/style-subset.json
